_note: SAMPLE_LAB privacy centre catalogue (CMP-061 + CMP-030 visibility + CMP-049 retention posture). Not statute. No DigiLocker/SMS/Payment. CERTIFIED=false · G6=false.

request_types.label: Access my data
request_types.description: Ask owning components for a copy of data in scope

request_types.label: Correct my data
request_types.description: Ask owning components to correct scoped records

request_types.label: Erase my data
request_types.description: Ask owning components to erase scoped records when policy allows

request_types.label: Port my data
request_types.description: Ask owning components for a portable export of scoped data

request_types.label: Withdraw consent
request_types.description: Request withdrawal of a granted purpose consent (orchestrated; not direct CMP-030 withdraw)

request_types.label: Restrict processing
request_types.description: Ask owning components to restrict processing of scoped data

retention.note: Retention periods are owner-supplied opaque refs (CMP-049). ARCHIVE/DELETE eligibility fail closed until bound. This centre never invents statute or purges foreign tables.
